study.title: RoWeeder: Unsupervised Weed Mapping through Crop-Row Detection

segmentation.domain: weed vs crop (sugar beet) vs background
segmentation.best_model: RoWeeder (Flat decoder): macro F1 0.753, params 3.60 M, inf. 7.16 ms

dataset.name: WeedMap (Rheinbach, Germany; Eschikon, Switzerland)
dataset.note: Multispectral UAV imagery of sugar beet fields: RedEdge-M (Rheinbach) and Sequoia (Eschikon); 8 orthomosaics [000]-[007]; 512x512 non-overlapping sliding tiles; Eschikon excluded (no blue channel); 5-fold cross-validation over Rheinbach subset; crops/weeds annotations used only for test evaluation; pseudo-ground-truth from crop-row detection (NDVI threshold 0.1, Hough Transform) used for training. GSD/altitude not reported in text.

mIoU.ambiguity: Macro-averaged F1 is the sole quality metric (5-fold CV).

F1.quote: our method achieved a mean F1 score of 75.3 (RoWeeder Flat 74.5/74.9/75.6/77.2/74.3, mean 75.3 ± 0.5)
F1.ambiguity: Macro-averaged F1, 5-fold CV on Rheinbach subset of WeedMap. Baselines: Hough+SLIC+ResNet50 71.2, Hough+CC 70.4, Hough+SLIC 70.4. Unsupervised training on pseudo-GT; test on true annotations.

Dice.ambiguity: F1 used; Dice-equivalent captured under F1.

weed_F1.quote: RoWeeder (Flat) per-class F1 (full): BG 98.4, Crop 70.9, Weed 56.6
weed_F1.ambiguity: Averaged over 5 folds, 'full' = all pixels in image; inter-row weed F1 0.598, intra-row weed F1 by definition ~0 (intra-row weeds labeled crop).

crop_F1.quote: RoWeeder (Flat) per-class F1: Crop 70.9 (full), inter-row 71.9, intra-row 42.4

edge.framework: PyTorch (SegFormer; trained on Leonardo cluster 4x NVIDIA A100-64GB)

fps.ambiguity: Inference time only; claims real-time suitability for drones (7 ms/image).

latency_ms.quote: our method achieves an inference time of 7ms ... Inference time was calculated on a single NVIDIA RTX 4090
latency_ms.ambiguity: DESKTOP NVIDIA RTX 4090 (512x512 tile). Future work: test on edge. Hough+SLIC+ResNet50 1620 ms; Hough+CC 84 ms; Hough+SLIC 377 ms. Model 'light enough to be deployed on Jetson TX2/Nano' but NOT measured on them => edge.reported false.

params_M.quote: RoWeeder model is lightweight, with only 3.6M parameters and 3.68 GMACs
params_M.ambiguity: Structural metric (reported). RoWeeder (Flat) 3.60 M; SegFormer variant 3.71 M; Pyramid 3.90 M; Hough+SLIC+ResNet50 23.51 M. Structural model metric, not edge deployment.

gflops.ambiguity: Paper reports 3.68 GMACs; converted to GFLOPS (x2, derived) for schema unit. Structural metric, desktop-measured.

issues: Only macro-averaged F1 reported as quality metric (no mIoU/PA/Dice).
Efficiency measured on desktop RTX 4090; edge deployment (Jetson TX2/Nano) claimed as motivation but not measured.
Eschikon subset omitted (no blue channel); experiments limited to Rheinbach subset.
Pseudo-ground-truth training means quality metrics reflect noise resilience; inter-row/intra-row per-class F1 values as reported.
